title: Follow the source-described AGV under-rack lift sequence during a tote exchange
summary: Verify the tote-exchange physical sequence described by the source: an AGV with no tote designated to the tote zone moves under the racking to position for a lift; the tote is lifted in position; then an AGV with an empty tote travels under the sorter behind it; the full-tote AGV moves out into the aisle while the empty-tote AGV moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack; finally, the AGV that just dropped its tote becomes the AGV that will pick up the next tote.
when_to_use: Use when you are observing/confirming a tote exchange and need to check that the AGV under-rack positioning, lift, and the subsequent full/empty AGV movements occur in the source-described order.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Observe AGV movements during the tote exchange and confirm the sequence order (under-rack positioning → lift → empty-under-sorter behind → full out to aisle / empty into rack and lowered → dropped-tote AGV becomes next picker).
access_or_tools_needed: Live system visibility of AGV movements under racking and at the sorter/rack locations

system_preconditions: A tote exchange is in progress such that AGVs are moving under the racking and under the sorter, and rack locations are being used for tote placement/lowering.

visual_references.description: Frame supporting the source-described exchange sequence: under-rack positioning for lift, tote lifted, empty-under-sorter behind, full out to aisle, empty into rack and lowered, and the dropped-tote AGV becoming the next picker.

steps.title: Identify the AGV described as having no tote and designated to the tote zone
steps.purpose: Establish the correct starting AGV for the source-described under-rack lift sequence.
steps.instruction: During the tote exchange, identify the AGV that the source describes as having no tote and being designated to the tote zone.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the AGV that is the “AGV with no tote” for the tote zone exchange sequence.
steps.healthy_condition: The identified AGV is the one participating in the exchange sequence that will move under the racking for a lift.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reliably identify which AGV is the “no tote” AGV for the tote zone, or you identify the wrong AGV such that later steps cannot be matched to the source order.

actions.label: Select the no-tote AGV for the tote zone
actions.exact_action: Identify the AGV that is described as having no tote and designated to the tote zone.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confidently identify the “no tote” AGV for the tote zone, stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: 'An AGV with no tote that is designated to the tote zone moves under the racking to position for a lift...'

steps.title: Observe the no-tote AGV move under the racking to position for a lift
steps.purpose: Confirm the first movement in the source-described exchange sequence.
steps.instruction: Watch the identified no-tote AGV move under the racking to position for a lift.
steps.expected_result: The no-tote AGV moves under the racking and reaches the position for the lift.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV’s movement under the racking occurs before the tote lift action described by the source.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not move under the racking to the lift position, or the lift occurs without the under-rack positioning step matching the source order.

actions.label: Verify under-rack positioning
actions.exact_action: Observe that this AGV moves under the racking to position for a lift.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order (e.g., lift does not occur after under-rack positioning), stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: 'An AGV with no tote that is designated to the tote zone moves under the racking to position for a lift...'

steps.title: Observe the tote being lifted in position
steps.purpose: Confirm the lift action that occurs after the under-rack positioning.
steps.instruction: Observe the tote lift in position as described by the source (the source describes an AGV running under the racks of the totes and lifting up a tote).
steps.expected_result: A tote is lifted in position by the AGV that is under the racks.
steps.healthy_condition: The lift occurs after the AGV has moved under the racking to position for the lift.
steps.failure_condition: No lift occurs, or the lift occurs out of order relative to the under-rack positioning.

actions.label: Verify tote lift
actions.exact_action: Observe that the tote is lifted in position (source describes an AGV running under the racks of the totes and lifting up a tote).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order (e.g., lift does not occur after under-rack positioning), stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: 'The tote is lifted in position... An AGV runs under the racks of the totes, lifts up a tote...'

steps.title: Observe the empty-tote AGV traveling under the sorter behind the lift sequence
steps.purpose: Confirm the next described movement that sets up the exchange outcome.
steps.instruction: Observe that an AGV with an empty tote travels under the sorter position itself behind the sequence.
steps.expected_result: An empty-tote AGV travels under the sorter behind the lift sequence.
steps.healthy_condition: The empty-tote AGV movement under the sorter occurs after the tote lift action described by the source.
steps.failure_condition: No empty-tote AGV travels under the sorter behind the lift sequence, or it occurs out of order.

actions.label: Verify empty-under-sorter behind movement
actions.exact_action: Observe the next described movement: an AGV with an empty tote travels under the sorter position itself behind it.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order, stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: 'An AGV with an empty tote that travels under the sorter... behind it...'

steps.title: Observe exchange outcome: full tote AGV out to aisle; empty tote AGV into rack location and lowered
steps.purpose: Confirm the exchange outcome movements that complete the tote swap.
steps.instruction: Observe that (1) the AGV with the full tote moves out into the aisle, and (2) the AGV with the empty tote moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack.
steps.expected_result: Full tote AGV moves out into the aisle; empty tote AGV moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack.
steps.healthy_condition: The full/empty movements match the source-described directions and lowering action occurs at the rack location.
steps.failure_condition: The full tote does not move out into the aisle, or the empty tote does not move into the rack location and lower into the rack as described.

actions.label: Verify full-out / empty-in-lower
actions.exact_action: Observe the exchange outcome movements: the AGV with the full tote moves out into the aisle, and the AGV with the empty tote moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order (e.g., lift does not occur after under-rack positioning), stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: '...the AGV with the full tote moves out into the aisle and the AGV with the empty tote moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack...'

steps.title: Confirm the post-exchange role transition: dropped-tote AGV becomes next picker
steps.purpose: Verify the source-described handoff so the next tote pickup is attributed to the correct AGV.
steps.instruction: After the empty tote is lowered into the rack, confirm that the AGV that just dropped its tote becomes the AGV that will pick up the next tote.
steps.expected_result: The AGV that just dropped its tote is the one that will pick up the next tote in the zone.
steps.healthy_condition: The next exchange sequence uses the same AGV as the “dropped-tote AGV” for the next pickup, consistent with the source-described transition.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV that dropped its tote does not become the next picker (i.e., a different AGV is used for the next pickup contrary to the source-described transition).

actions.label: Verify next-picker AGV
actions.exact_action: Confirm the role transition described by the source: the AGV that just dropped its tote becomes the AGV that will pick up the next tote.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order, stop and request support/clarification.

evidence_source_refs: training_video_day1_segment_0015 transcript: 'This AGV that just dropped its tote will now become the AGV that will pick up the next tote.'

success_criteria: You can describe the exchange sequence as: under-rack positioning for lift → tote lifted → empty-under-sorter behind → full out to aisle / empty into rack and lowered → dropped-tote AGV becomes next picker.
healthy_conditions: Lift occurs after under-rack positioning of the no-tote AGV.
An empty-tote AGV travels under the sorter behind the lift sequence.
Full-tote AGV moves out into the aisle; empty-tote AGV moves into the rack location and lowers its empty tote into the rack.
The AGV that just dropped its tote becomes the AGV that will pick up the next tote.
failure_conditions: Observed sequence does not match the source-described order (e.g., lift does not occur after under-rack positioning).
Full/empty outcome movements do not match the source-described directions (full not out to aisle; empty not into rack location and lowered).
Post-exchange role transition does not occur as described (dropped-tote AGV does not become next picker).
escalation_guidance: If the observed sequence does not match the source-described order, stop and request support/clarification.
